source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Each battle round, both players take 1 turn; the mission names who goes first, and that player goes first in every round. Each turn runs in this order:

1. Start of Turn step: resolve rules that trigger as the turn begins.
2. Command phase.
3. Movement phase.
4. Shooting phase.
5. Charge phase.
6. Fight phase.
7. End of Turn step: resolve rules other than mission rules, then any mission aspects either player has achieved that trigger now.

A rule that lets a unit move, shoot, charge or fight out of sequence does not unlock other rules tied to a named phase.

A trigger tied to the start of any round, turn or phase fires every time; one naming “the” turn or phase, not yours or your opponent’s, fires in both players’.
